note: No `vetterDid` filter. A lookup by DID would answer "is this member a vetter?" for anyone, listed or not — the one question a listing must not answer. An applicant who has a vetter's DID checks eligibility through vetting/request's `eligibilityVp`.
`cursor` is a non-empty token. An empty string is not the first page — omit the member instead.
`language` is a BCP 47 tag, not a language name.
`country` is an upper-case ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, the same form a profile stores.
`method` comes from the shared VettingMethod vocabulary. `phone` is not a vetting method.
`eventTo` is a date, not a date-time; events are matched by UTC date.
No `listed` filter. Unlisted profiles are never returned, so there is nothing to select.
